lesson.title: Example Embedded Lesson

props.name: Prompt
props.content:
###### 🚀 Mission 1 · Multiple Choice

## Which planet zooms around **closest to the Sun**?

choices.feedback: Correct! Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun. A year there is only 88 Earth days!
Close! Venus is the second planet from the Sun. Look for the tiny, speedy one.
Earth is our home, the third planet from the Sun.
Mars is the fourth planet, the Red Planet. Try one closer in!

props.name: Prompt
props.content:
###### 🪐 Mission 2 · Select All That Apply

## Which of these planets are **gas giants**?

Pick every one you think is right, then check your answer.

choices.feedback: Yes! Saturn is a gas giant wrapped in beautiful rings.
Mars is rocky and dusty, not a gas giant.
Yes! Jupiter is the biggest gas giant of all.
Earth is a rocky planet. You can stand on it!

props.name: Prompt
props.content:
###### ✨ Mission 3 · Fill in the Blank

## Name the **biggest planet** in our solar system

It's so big that all the other planets could fit inside it!

props.name: Largest planet
props.correctFeedback: Out of this world! Jupiter is the largest planet.
props.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. Hint: it has a Great Red Spot, a storm bigger than Earth.

props.name: Prompt
props.content:
###### ☀️ Mission 4 · Put in Order

## Line up the **inner planets** from the Sun outward

Drag the cards so the closest planet is on top.

props.name: Inner planets order
props.correctFeedback: Perfect lineup! Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars.
props.incorrectFeedback: Almost! Remember: Mercury is closest and Mars is the farthest inner planet.

props.name: Prompt
props.content:
###### 🔭 Mission 5 · Matching

## Match each planet to its **fun fact**

Drag a fact onto the planet it describes.

props.name: Planet facts

props.content: Has a giant ocean of lava

props.correctFeedback: Super sleuth! You matched every fact.
props.incorrectFeedback: Some facts are in the wrong place. Try moving them around!

props.name: Prompt
props.content:
###### 🪨 Mission 6 · Sort It Out

## Is each planet **rocky** or a **giant**?

Choose one column for every planet.

props.name: Rocky or giant

rows.incorrectFeedback: Earth is rocky. We live on its surface!

props.overallCorrectFeedback: Stellar sorting! You know your planets.
props.overallIncorrectFeedback: A few planets are in the wrong column. Rocky planets are the four closest to the Sun.

props.name: Prompt
props.content:
###### 🌍 Mission 7 · Complete the Sentence

## Finish this message about **home sweet home**

Pick the right word for each blank.

props.name: Earth and Moon
props.passage: Earth is the [[1]] planet from the Sun. It takes about [[2]] days to travel once around the Sun, and our [[3]] orbits Earth about once a month.
props.correctFeedback: Mission complete! You really know your home planet.
props.incorrectFeedback: Check each blank again. You've got this!
